name: SimpleSafetyTests
description: The past year has seen rapid acceleration in the development of large language models (LLMs). However, without proper steering and safeguards, LLMs will readily follow malicious instructions, provide unsafe advice, and generate toxic content. We introduce SimpleSafetyTests (SST) as a new test suite for rapidly and systematically identifying such critical safety risks.
reputation: A lightweight safety test suite that has been used as a practical screening benchmark for LLM harmfulness and refusal behavior.
notes: Primarily a red-teaming style benchmark; scores depend heavily on model refusal policy and prompt setup, and it is not a standard closed-form accuracy benchmark.
